new.name: HYPOTHESIZES_ANOMALY_CAUSE
new.definition: The reasoning proposes a specific candidate explanation for an unexpected observation or unexplained system state, and treats that explanation as provisional.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text offering a candidate cause for the observed anomaly or unexpected state.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning flags a state or result as unexpected, conflicting, or noteworthy.
The reasoning offers a concrete candidate cause or source for that state.
The candidate explanation is expressed with remaining uncertainty (e.g., 'probably', 'might be', 'could be').
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only restates or quotes the unexpected observation without proposing any cause.
The reasoning reports an already verified fact with no remaining uncertainty and no candidate explanation.

new.name: CONFORMS_IMPLEMENTATION_TO_DISCOVERED_PATTERN
new.definition: The reasoning treats a pre-existing configuration or artifact revealed by the observation as the intended or authoritative design and commits to adjusting the agent's own implementation targets or values to match it, rather than overriding it.

parameters.name: conforming_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that interprets the discovered artifact as the intended design and states the alignment changes.

parameters.name: pattern_observation
parameters.description: The observation revealing the pre-existing configuration or artifacts.

assertion_conditions: The observation reveals pre-existing configuration or artifacts relevant to the goal.
The reasoning interprets that pre-existing artifact as intended, authoritative, or a design to be preserved.
The reasoning states concrete changes to the agent's own implementation (targets, paths, values, or the removal of its own competing artifacts) so as to match the discovered pattern.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning notes the pre-existing artifact but retains its own independent design.
The reasoning treats the discovered artifact as an obstacle to be replaced without deriving any implementation values from it.

new.name: REMOVES_SUPERSEDED_ARTIFACTS_TO_RESOLVE_CONFLICT
new.definition: An action deletes or undoes artifacts the agent itself previously created or that duplicate an authoritative configuration, where the reasoning identified them as redundant or conflicting and intended to keep the authoritative one.

parameters.name: cleanup_action
parameters.description: The action performing the removal or dismantling of the superseded artifacts.

parameters.name: conflict_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that identifies the duplication or conflict and prescribes removal while retaining the authoritative artifact.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a duplication or conflict caused by artifacts that duplicate or overlap an authoritative configuration.
The cleanup action removes exactly those redundant or conflicting artifacts.
The authoritative configuration referenced in the reasoning is left in place by the action.
exclusion_conditions: The action removes artifacts unrelated to any identified duplication or conflict.
The action merely overwrites or patches the offending artifact instead of removing it.
No reasoning identifies the duplication or decides that removal is required.

new.name: PLANS_CAPABILITY_ACQUISITION_WITH_FALLBACK
new.definition: Prompted by an observation that a required tool or capability is unavailable, the reasoning commits to an attempt to acquire it while specifying an alternative approach that avoids the dependency, so progress is possible either way.

parameters.name: acquisition_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that reacts to the capability gap by planning acquisition and an alternative approach.

parameters.name: capability_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting that the required tool or capability is absent or unavailable.

assertion_conditions: The observation shows that a needed tool, package, or capability is missing or that an availability check failed.
The reasoning plans a concrete attempt to obtain the missing capability.
The reasoning also states at least one alternative approach that achieves the goal without that capability.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning simply reattempts the same unavailable capability without any alternative plan.
The observation shows the capability is available, so no gap exists.
The reasoning abandons the goal instead of planning acquisition or an alternative.

uncertain.definition: After an action fails because a required parameter is missing or invalid, the reasoning identifies the specific defect and the subsequent action repeats the same operation with the corrected parameter supplied.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the validation error or invalid-argument failure of the earlier attempt.

parameters.name: correction_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that names the missing or invalid parameter and states how the retry will fix it.

parameters.name: retry_action
parameters.description: The action repeating the same operation with the corrected parameter included.

assertion_conditions: The failure observation reports a parameter validation error or invalid/missing argument for an attempted operation.
The correction reasoning identifies the specific missing or invalid parameter.
The retry action performs the same operation as the failed attempt and includes the previously missing or corrected parameter.
exclusion_conditions: The failure is not attributable to a parameter or argument problem.
The retry changes the operation itself or the goal rather than supplying the identified parameter.
No reasoning connects the failure to the corrected retry.

uncertain.definition: The reasoning defines a verification procedure that deliberately reproduces the externally stated acceptance checks (same operations and expected outputs) so the agent can self-confirm compliance before declaring completion.

parameters.name: validation_plan_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning specifying the end-to-end verification procedure that mirrors the stated acceptance checks.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning refers to the externally stated acceptance checks or test procedure.
The reasoning specifies verification steps that reproduce those checks, including the expected outputs to be compared.
The validation is presented as a prerequisite for considering the task complete.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning describes only a general sanity check that does not reproduce the stated acceptance criteria.
The reasoning merely restates the requirements without constructing an executable verification procedure.

parameters.name: interpretation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that classifies the result as expected given the known current state.

parameters.name: negative_result_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the empty, missing, or error-like result being interpreted.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports a missing resource, empty response, error status, or otherwise negative-looking outcome.
The reasoning states that this outcome follows from a known precondition or incomplete stage of the work.
The reasoning does not treat the outcome as evidence that the configuration is broken.
